body:
Parent: #1726
Depends on: #2181, #1713, #2151

## 原子目标

实现authorization-bypass与migration-legacy两类非canonical fixture的独立producer/receipts/storage roots/consumer admission，使其显式标记、最小权限、不可进入authentication/MFA/Passkey/recovery/refresh/step-up correctness或release evidence。本issue只负责两类隔离，不生成canonical sessions、不删除legacy paths。

## 必须交付

1. Authorization-bypass producer exact接受#2181声明的diagnostic/non-auth consumers和capability scope，receipt/storage强制`authenticationBypassed=true`与truth class，不允许canonical label或隐式默认。
2. Bypass只提供必要authorization context/value DTO或受控middleware grant，不能伪造Passkey/TOTP/recovery/session completion、写credential/session DB、生成canonical proof或改变auth strength。
3. Bypass grants绑定run/source/profile/consumer/test/site/user/admin/action/purpose/TTL，默认deny、exact consumer、short-lived、可撤销；不得wildcard admin/editor/all。
4. Bypass storage/root与canonical private projections物理/逻辑隔离，canonical consumer无法读取，文件名/路径不能伪装canonical。
5. Migration-legacy producer只生成当前migration reader明确支持的legacy_verified/legacy_unverified等输入，绑定schema/version/source/expected migration result；普通runtime/correctness consumer一律拒绝。
6. Legacy fixtures不得携带current canonical claims/receipts让consumer误判完成，也不得作为canonical fallback或“兼容一个版本”长期保留。
7. 每类producer/receipt/verifier exact-one、closed/versioned；unknown legacy/bypass field/schema fail closed。
8. Consumer admission读取#2181registry，拒绝class/variant不合格、missing marker、cross-run/source/profile、stale/expired/revoked与tamper。
9. Bypass/legacy结果不能进入release-final required auth authority、three-run qualification或canonical fixture receipt aggregation。
10. Disable/profile teardown/logout撤销bypass grants/storage；legacy input cleanup只删除owned migration fixture，不触碰canonical/user data。
11. Receipts记录truth class、consumer/purpose/scope/TTL、legacy schema/expected migration、storage refs/digests与status，不记录token/secret。
12. Static governance禁止bypass canonical-positive、legacy fallback、shared storage、wildcard consumers与auth correctness acceptance。

## 固定约束

- 不生成canonical authentication sessions，归#2182。
- 不删除hand-signed/legacy/compat paths，归#2184。
- 不修改production authentication/authorization/migration semantics。
- 不实现product auth UI。
- 不修改#1794。

## 必须测试

- bypass labeled canonical；
- bypass used Passkey/MFA/recovery/refresh/stepup test；
- bypass writes session/credential DB；
- wildcard admin/all grant；
- canonical/bypass shared storage；
- migration legacy accepted runtime correctness；
- legacy receipt carries canonical claims；
- legacy used as canonical fallback；
- missing authenticationBypassed marker；
- stale/expired/revoked/cross-consumer；
- release-final/qualification consumes bypass/legacy；
- cleanup deletes canonical/user data；
- receipt/storage tamper。

## 验收条件

- [ ] Bypass与legacy fixtures独立、显式、consumer/purpose-bound且默认拒绝。
- [ ] 两类都不能伪装或替代canonical authentication truth。
- [ ] Bypass不写canonicalsession/credential/proof facts，legacy仅供migration。
- [ ] Release/correctness/qualification完整拒绝bypass/legacy。
- [ ] 本PR不生成canonical sessions或删除旧路径。

## 非目标

- 不定义truth classes。
- 不实现canonical variants。
- 不删除legacy/hand-signed paths。
- 不测试产品认证UI。
title: feat(test-fixtures): 隔离 authorization-bypass 与 migration-legacy auth fixtures
